full_details: Kettleby found you at the Feathers among the baskets, before the boat, with my lord's purse. Four pounds, for hose, in eight parts of ten shillings. The Queen's three nights stayed on the other leaf. An office is still empty. You are looked for again at Twelfth Day. Two borrowed cloaks went back to a yeoman, counted. You came down on the ebb in the tilt-boat and were at Old Swan by two. Nick asked what a queen does when she is a man, and you told him he has time to learn how to stand. At the Bull, nobody had proposed the sitting. Kemp told the button at last, with spoons for the yeomen's tapers. You walked the two hundred yards home. Mistress Ansell had her promises on the stair, and Gib was on the Chaucer. You put the ten shillings behind both locks and did not count the rest.
one_sentence: You came down the river with my lord's ten shillings, sat to lamb's-wool at the Bull, and put the money behind both locks.
title: Put my lord's ten shillings behind both locks
